name: std/hashmap
description: Mutable open-addressed maps for hot text-keyed lookup paths. Values are shallow-copied into backend-owned storage.
readme: Mutable open-addressed maps for hot text-keyed lookup paths. Values are shallow-copied into backend-owned storage.
Import this module with use hashmap.

files.content:
-- Mutable open-addressed maps for hot text-keyed lookup paths.
-- Values are shallow-copied into backend-owned storage.
public define HashMap as opaque.
public use "hashmap" function create[V]() giving fallible pointer to HashMap.
public use "hashmap" function put[V](collection pointer to HashMap, key text, value V) giving fallible nothing.
public use "hashmap" function get[V](collection pointer to HashMap, key text) giving fallible V.
public use "hashmap" function contains[V](collection pointer to HashMap, key text) giving fallible boolean.
public use "hashmap" function remove[V](collection pointer to HashMap, key text) giving fallible boolean.
public use "hashmap" function length[V](collection pointer to HashMap) giving fallible unsigned 64.
public use "hashmap" function close[V](collection pointer to HashMap) giving fallible nothing.
